_comment: Open items that block mainnet. preflight --network mainnet is red while any item without "auto" is not "resolved". Items with "auto" are decided by preflight's own checks, never by editing this file: "ceremony" = ceremony/TRANSCRIPT.md + a full re-verification + the vkey baked into veyl_pool (ceremony/check.mjs); "program-ids" = fresh keypairs outside the repo, the mainnet build profile embedding them and no dev ID; "roles" = no role of the live deployment left on the deployer key; "committee" = a real batch-committee DKG transcript (committee/transcript.mainnet.json: at least 2 of 3, distinct node keys, not a local session, every signature and key re-verified). The external audit has no automatic check: set it to "resolved" with "evidence" (the published report) only when an independent firm has audited the programs, the circuit and the browser engine.

items.title: Multi-party phase-2 ceremony for all five circuits (withdraw, transact, position, swap, claim) with independent contributors on the public Powers of Tau (ceremony/README.md): kit + rehearsal done; the real ceremony with real participants is not
External audit of the three programs, the five circuits, the committee node and the browser engine. REVIEW.md is an internal review (a stand-in), not an audit
Sealed swaps: the batch committee's key generation run by independent operators (DEPLOY.md, Batch committee), its transcript published and registered
Fresh mainnet program keypairs outside the repo, mainnet build profile (npm run keys:mainnet)
After deploy: upgrade authority, pool + factory authority, postman moved off the deployer key (npm run handover)
